description: Prepare an application to an Actual group offer on behalf of the candidate you are assisting. Returns a personal link, valid 72 hours, that the candidate must open to attach their CV and give consent to the processing of their data; the application is only sent once they submit that page. Only call this when the candidate has asked to apply and given you their name and email. Never submit the page yourself: give the link to the candidate.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Describe the job seeker's or recruiter's goal in one short sentence. Do not include names, emails or phone numbers.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

lang.description: Language of the application page. Defaults to fr.

llm_model.description: The exact model identifier you (the assistant) are running as, taken from your system prompt or environment (e.g. "claude-opus-4-8", "gpt-5.2"). Used for analytics only. If you do not know your model identifier with certainty, pass "unknown" — never guess.

slug.description: Slug of the offer, from search_offers or get_offer.

name: start_application
title: Start a job application
